<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="revolution-strategy"><ins><nowiki>Revolution++ Strategy</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>It’s possible to “semi-AFK” the Dagannoth Kings by switching weapons and using revolution, even without any hybrid armour. Normally, using armour that’s off-style has an accuracy penalty i.e. if using a Melee weapon, then magic/ranged armour will lower accuracy. For DKs, a combination of T90 weapons + overloads + T80 power armour of different styles will ensure 100% accuracy on all three kings. Higher armour or lower tier weapons will affect accuracy, but adding prayers/curses will get accuracy back up to 100%.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The strategy here is to wear power armour of different types i.e. (melee helm, ranged body, magic legs), and swap weapons/prayer for each king. This requires two clicks/key binds every kill, but is otherwise auto-pilot.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Camp Soul Split </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Switch to the respective T95/T99 Curses (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1" alt="anguish" title="anguish" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1" alt="turmoil" title="turmoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1" alt="Affliction" title="Affliction" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159018098713.png?v=1" alt="Desolation" title="Desolation" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1" alt="Malevolence" title="Malevolence" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) as you kill the Kings</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ ~160kph with T85-87 weapons in a standard instance</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ ~200kph with T90 weapons + a custom instance for fast re-spawns</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
